_comment: Sorrowfen's peak (content-zone-7-swamp.md §2.3 quest B): the gnome Fennick, after mushrooms-for-the-gnome, sends the player into the spiders' den to kill the Spider Queen, a group boss, and bring back her venom. The turn-in teaches FenTonic, his cure. Priced at L12 by the half-level rule, 0.5 x 300 x 1.2^11. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
